scope.contract: Original immutable I-005 and s3 DeleteSelection{range:null|Range} / RippleDeleteClips. This slice opens only an explicit continuous TimeRange on the existing RippleDeleteClips command, mutually exclusive with clip ids, including a vacated insert-move source hole as one persistent command. Insert-mode MoveClips is unchanged and still leaves the source as a gap; no new MoveClips mode (ripple/closeSource) is added. Clip-id ripple delete, leave-gap delete/trim, shorten-only RippleTrimClip, and reject/overwrite/insert stay distinct. Ripple-trim lengthening, auto-close-on-move, new-track creation, cross-project bake and the OS clipboard are not implemented. I-006 roll/slip/slide and the full trim planner remain unopened.
scope.temporalSemantics: Range-only RippleDeleteClips([], range: TimeRange(start, duration)) closes one continuous interval R=[a,b) on participating tracks. For a range-only request, targets are empty, so the default participating set is syncLock media; an explicit rippleTrackIds list cannot include a caption track. Split the later bound first, then a. Items fully inside R are dropped; spanning items keep remapped remnants; later items shift by -L. Sequence duration shrinks by L, but not below later ends on unmoved non-ripple tracks. Assets are kept. Remnants are not auto-joined. Insert-move still grows duration and leaves a source gap until this range close is applied.
scope.preserved: Clip-id ripple delete still uses includeLinks=true and is unchanged. Range and clip ids are mutually exclusive (RIPPLE_RANGE_AND_SELECTION). Empty ids without range still EMPTY_SELECTION. Negative range start is NEGATIVE_TIMELINE_START. TimeRange still throws INVALID_RANGE for non-positive duration. Source time, cropped opacity curves, static effects, proxy/asset version refs and audio offsets are preserved. Locks on a written field raise FIELD_LOCKED. A locked syncLock non-target that would have to crop or shift raises SYNC_LOCKED (range-only has no selected targets, so a locked syncLock track is SYNC_LOCKED). Whole-group atomic refusal, never a silent subset. Transitions whose cut is strictly inside R, or whose endpoints vanish or lose adjacency, are dropped; later cuts remap and subtract L. Absolute captions that would have to crop or shift (cue end > R.start) refuse CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; caption cue-follow/anchor policy is not opened.
scope.history: Each range close is one existing persistent command with snapshot undo/redo, save/reopen, archive fork and AAC MP4 export. No new persistence schema or fingerprint side branch.
scope.ui: Workbench adds Ripple close range (key ripple-close-range) with start/duration second fields (keys ripple-close-start / ripple-close-duration) parsed by existing _snapDecimal. Existing leave-gap trim/delete, ripple-delete, ripple-trim, and insert-move controls are unchanged. The official UI test pre-seeds the insert-move via workspace.edit; the close itself is the UI command under test. UI tests jump foundation-scroll and do not drag through the pointer timeline.
